note: Per-OS packaging recipes. build.sh ship reads this and invokes the right tool. Real installer builds happen in CI (see .github/workflows/ci.yml release job) where the tools are pre-installed.

linux.notes: Requires appimage-builder ≥ 1.1. CI job installs via pip.

windows.notes: Requires NSIS ≥ 3.x. CI job installs via choco.
